articles.title: SoFi, Kraken tie up as crypto and banking push into each other's turf
articles.snippet: Kraken is joining SoFi's settlement network and list SoFiUSD as the companies link traditional banking with crypto markets.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto VCs are mistaking consensus for discipline
articles.snippet: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, Varun Datta of Truth Ventures writes that crypto venture capital's retreat to later-stage deals is a consensus trade dressed as discipline. With proven companies taking 57% of last quarter's capital, he argues the founding-stage gap is where the returns are, and lays out three things to look for.

articles.title: Michigan authorities continue pursuit to block Kalshi as Supreme Court fight looms
articles.snippet: Kalshi previously said it had been placed in an “impossible position” after federal authorities directed the company to ignore a Michigan restraining order issued in June.

articles.title: Pencil Finance completes $1M onchain lending cycle for 6.6K students in Southeast Asia
articles.snippet: Pencil Finance said that its first-of-a-kind loan offered financing to 6,600 students in Southeast Asia who were underserved by traditional lenders.

articles.title: Sony Dismisses PS5 Buyers' $508M Tariff Refund Claim as 'Illogical'
articles.snippet: The company raised PlayStation prices for a second time in March, five weeks after the tariffs were struck down.
